chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
I am not worried by a fault after which I am given time to offer two units of prayer and ask Allah for safety.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of praying two rak'ahs after a sin in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) illustrates the efficacy of immediate *Salat al-Hawd* (Prayer of Well-being) as a spiritual remedy, where the act of repentance alleviates the distress of the sin itself. This hadith underscores the Shia emphasis on proactive self-accountability and the transformative power of voluntary prayer in restoring one's connection with the Divine after moral lapse.
